006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupMultiline;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
010
011import java.util.Locale;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016/**
017 * An Metaschema model instance representing a grouped set of objects consisting
018 * of heterogeneous object types.
019 */
020public interface IChoiceGroupInstance
021    extends IModelInstanceAbsolute, IContainerModelGrouped, IJsonInstance {
022
023  /**
024   * The default max-occurs value for a choice group. {@code -1} represents an
025   * unbounded occurance.
026   */
027  int DEFAULT_CHOICE_GROUP_GROUP_AS_MAX_OCCURS = -1;
028
029  /**
030   * The default JSON property value used to identify the specific type of the
031   * object.
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  String DEFAULT_JSON_DISCRIMINATOR_PROPERTY_NAME = "object-type";
035
036  /**
037   * {@inheritDoc}
038   *
039   * @see #DEFAULT_CHOICE_GROUP_GROUP_AS_MAX_OCCURS
040   */
041  @Override
042  default int getMaxOccurs() {
043    return DEFAULT_CHOICE_GROUP_GROUP_AS_MAX_OCCURS;
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Provides the Metaschema model type of "CHOICE".
048   *
049   * @return the model type
050   */
051  @Override
052  default ModelType getModelType() {
053    return ModelType.CHOICE_GROUP;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  default String getJsonName() {
058    return ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(getGroupAsName(), "Missing group-as name");
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Get the JSON property to use to discriminate between JSON objects.
063   *
064   * @return the discriminator property
065   * @see #DEFAULT_JSON_DISCRIMINATOR_PROPERTY_NAME
066   */
067  @NonNull
068  String getJsonDiscriminatorProperty();
069
070  @Override
071  default boolean isEffectiveValueWrappedInXml() {
072    return true;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get the effective name of the JSON key flag, if a JSON key is configured.
077   * <p>
078   * This name is expected to be in the same namespace as the containing model
079   * element (i.e. choice group, assembly, field).
080   *
081   * @return the name of the JSON key flag if configured, or {@code null}
082   *         otherwise
083   */
084  @Nullable
085  String getJsonKeyFlagInstanceName();
086
087  /**
088   * Get the named model instance for the provided choice group item.
089   *
090   * @param item
091   *          the item to get the instance for
092   * @return the named model instance for the provided choice group item
093   */
094  @NonNull
095  default INamedModelInstanceGrouped getItemInstance(@NonNull Object item) {
096    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Method not needed.");
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  default MarkupMultiline getRemarks() {
101    // no remarks
102    return null;
103  }
104
105  @SuppressWarnings("null")
106  @Override
107  default String toCoordinates() {
108    return String.format("%s-instance:%s:%s/%s@%d",
109        getModelType().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
110        getContainingDefinition().getContainingModule().getShortName(),
111        getContainingDefinition().getName(),
112        getGroupAsName(),
113        hashCode());
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * A visitor callback.
118   *
119   * @param <CONTEXT>
120   *          the type of the context parameter
121   * @param <RESULT>
122   *          the type of the visitor result
123   * @param visitor
124   *          the calling visitor
125   * @param context
126   *          a parameter used to pass contextual information between visitors
127   * @return the visitor result
128   */
129  @Override
130  default <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(@NonNull IModelElementVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor, CONTEXT context) {
131    return visitor.visitChoiceGroupInstance(this, context);
132  }
133}
